scenes.anchor_text: ENDNOTE“Above silence, the illuminating storms—dying storms— illuminate the silence above.”The above sample is noteworthy as it is a ketek, a complex form of holy Vorin poem. The ketek not only reads the same forward and backward  but is also divisible into five distinct smaller sections, each of which makes a complete thought.
scenes.scene_description: A vast, desolate landscape under the throes of a dying storm, illuminated by flashes of lightning, emphasizing the silence both during and after the storm's passage.
